artifacts.summary: Eleven-phase plan: wire the compiled refutation of CellLEZeroConstOfKappaEq as the forty-seventh probe, repair (K4) with the forward exactness depth dFwd, probe the regime-B open core at a decision gate, land the certificate-free type-preserving pump layer (LadderPump.lean, LadderChain.lean) with eight pinned Lean Challenge Statements, and attempt the depth-0 theorem only on the gate's PASS branch.

memory_candidates.content: When one task both wires a refutation probe against a library predicate and then repairs that predicate, order the phases wire-first/repair-second and re-anchor the probe in the SAME phase as the repair: freeze a verbatim local copy of the pre-repair conjunct (e.g. paramsOkK4Pre / ParamsOkPre) and restate the refuted schema locally against it, so the refutation remains a theorem about a named object after the library definition changes and no commit leaves the evidence gate red. Add two positive facts in the same probe: the repaired predicate rejects the refuting parameter, and the specific collision dissolves at the repaired output. Precedent: AtomPreservingCountMove kept as a def so its refutation is a theorem.
